tools.name: create_folder
tools.description: Creates a new folder at the specified filesystem path

tools.name: delete_item
tools.description: Deletes a file or folder after user confirmation

tools.name: sort_directory
tools.description: Moves directory files into categorized subfolders by type

tools.name: install_app
tools.description: Installs an application via winget or chocolatey package manager

tools.name: open_vscode
tools.description: Launches VS Code optionally opening a specified file or folder

tools.name: focus_editor
tools.description: Brings the VS Code window to the foreground

tools.name: type_code
tools.description: Types text into the currently focused VS Code editor

tools.description: Opens a new untitled file in VS Code with Ctrl+N

tools.description: Saves the current VS Code file using Ctrl+S

tools.description: Toggles the VS Code integrated terminal with Ctrl+backtick

tools.name: open_and_type
tools.description: Creates new file, types code into it, and optionally saves

tools.name: talk_back
